title: #UjimaWednesdays
description: Boston Ujima Project's weekly member meetings, open to the public and dedicated to financial and political education and to Ujima's member working groups. Autumn 2026 sessions are a series on money — a talkback on "hard currencies" with Dr. Jared Ball and Dr. Erika Brown, "Monetary Trust" with Dr. Jessica Gordon-Nembhard, and a history of money with legal historian Christine Desan, author of Making Money — alongside hands-on workshops such as a mending session. Venue changes week to week (several are at COOP Social Club in Jamaica Plain); Ujima posts each one on its events page. Past sessions are on Ujima's YouTube channel.

recurrence.schedule: Every Wednesday from 6pm ET, in person in Boston; the venue varies, so check Ujima's events page for each week's location and RSVP.
